title: Verifiable Agent Summit
summary: In-person summit on verifiable agent control. TRACE is the evidence, ATF is the judgment, AAuth is the delivery.

title: 498 MCP Registry Entries Point at a Repository the Publisher Does Not Own
event: [un]prompted II, The AI Security Practitioner Conference
summary: The official MCP registry checks the repository field with a shape regex. 498 entries name a repository owned by a different account than the publisher authenticated as, and a worm shipped through the gap.

title: Weight Custody Manifest: When the Model Leaves Your Data Center, the Threat Model Flips
event: AAIF Community Showcase, Agentic AI Foundation
summary: Every model-weight protection tool protects the customer from the model. None protect the builder from the customer.

title: AgenTrust: From Governance Decisions to Verifiable Agent Actions
summary: Most agent governance tools can decide whether an action should be allowed. Far fewer can prove what was actually requested, authorised and executed across agents, tools and infrastructure. This is about closing that gap.

title: Verifiable Agent Summit, virtual edition
summary: Virtual edition of the summit, covering the TRACE evidence layer and how it composes with judgment and delivery.

title: Policy Enforcement and Tamper-Evident Audit Chains
summary: Enforcing policy at the MCP tool-call boundary, and producing an audit chain a third party can check rather than a log the operator writes about itself.

title: From Trust to Proof: The Next Generation of AI Agent Governance
summary: The gap between software-based AI governance and verifiable, hardware-enforced agent control, and the four open projects that close it: Agent Manifest, Confidential MCP, Confidential A2A, and TRACE.

title: Cloud Native Seattle Meetup, June 2026
summary: Agent governance and verifiable enforcement for a cloud native audience. Segment begins around 32 minutes into the recording.

title: Governing AI Agents at the Hardware Boundary
summary: Bridging agent governance policy and verifiable hardware enforcement, delivered the same day OPAQUE 3.0 and Confidential MCP were announced.

title: Governance for AI Agents
summary: GitHub's Open Source Friday livestream on governing AI agents with open-source tooling.

title: Governing AI Agents at Runtime: Open Source Zero-Trust with AGT
summary: Zero-trust principles applied to AI agent systems at runtime, using the open-source Agent Governance Toolkit.

title: Building Governed AI Agents with the Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit
summary: Enterprise AI governance in practice: defining agent policy and enforcing it with the Agent Governance Toolkit.

title: AGT (Agent Governance Toolkit): The Runtime Guardrail, What and Why
summary: AI Governance, Security and Compliance in 2026, part 1. Where the runtime guardrail sits between an agent's decision and its action, and what it can enforce that a prompt cannot.

title: Proof, Not Promises: Attesting What Your AI Agent Is
